concurrency_and_state: PacketDispatcher._handlers (Dictionary<sbyte, IPacketHandler>) is populated once in the constructor with no synchronization; safe only if dispatched solely from the Unity main thread.

MobController uses static mutable state (IsPickingItems, IsWait, TimeStartWait, TimeWait, ItemPicks, IndexItemPick, lastHarvestBeanTime) and static shared MyVector buffers (attackMobVector, emptyVector) driven from the main update loop.
MapController and PetService singletons use non-thread-safe lazy initialization (instance == null ? instance = new ... : instance).
Controller.loadCurrMap resets GameScr/Char UI and input lock flags (isStopReadMessage=false, Char.isLockKey=false, Char.ischangingMap=false) and clears pointer/key state on map load completion.

Controller.messageNotMap case 10 swaps local msg to messWait, calls loadInfoMap, and calls cleanup() on messWait before nulling it; original msg is not cleaned up (though Message.cleanup() is currently an empty stub).
cross_module_questions: Verify NetworkOpcodes.cs constants against hardcoded cases in modular handlers: PacketDispatcher registers AuthPacketHandler under NetworkOpcodes.LOGOUT while AuthPacketHandler handles -26 (SERVER_ALERT); PlayerStatsPacketHandler is registered under UPDATE_HP/UPDATE_MP/UPDATE_EXP/UPDATE_NANG_DONG while handling 6/-69/-68/-97; TaskNpcPacketHandler is registered under TASK_UPDATE/NPC_MENU/NPC_CHAT while handling -70/38/32.

Verify Server-side validation for charMove and pickItem against client-side auto-teleportation in MobController.MoveTo, MobController.Update (tsPlayer), MapController.NextMap, and distance-bypassing item pickup in MobController.GetTypePickItem.

Verify whether Server sends any bytes for the empty loop at Controller.cs:5106-5109 (num = msg.reader().readByte(); for (byte b2 = 0; b2 < num; b2++) {}) in loadInfoMap; if non-zero, client stream desyncs.
Verify Server trade gold field type for TRADE_ACTION action==6: TradePacketHandler.cs:67 reads int friendMoneyGD instead of long, whereas Char.xu is long.

findings.impact: IndexOutOfRangeException crash when serializing a single byte/bool at exact buffer boundary (e.g., byte 2048).
findings.root_cause: writeSByte calls checkLenght(0), and checkLenght checks `posWrite + ltemp > lenght`. When posWrite == lenght (e.g., 2048), `2048 + 0 > 2048` evaluates false, then `buffer[posWrite++] = value` writes out of bounds.
findings.title: Off-by-one capacity check in myWriter.writeSByte causes IndexOutOfRangeException at buffer boundary

findings.impact: Silent packet corruption/desync on truncated payloads instead of failing fast; read(ref sbyte[]) never signals EOF.
findings.root_cause: readSByte/readShort/readInt/readLong silently clamp posRead to buffer.Length and return 0 on EOF; readString truncates num to remaining bytes; read(ref sbyte[]) checks `if (posRead > buffer.Length) return -1;` which is unreachable because readSByte clamps posRead == buffer.Length.
findings.title: myReader silently returns 0/truncated data on EOF and read(ref sbyte[]) EOF check is dead code

findings.impact: NullReferenceException crash in Controller.messageSubCommand case 35 when player has no mobFocus and another char shares cTypePk; wrong char lookup skips actual players in map.
findings.root_cause: Loop iterates `i` from 0 to vCharInMap.size() but calls `GameScr.findCharInMap(i)` (lookup by charID instead of elementAt(i)), and accesses `Char.myCharz().mobFocus.isMobMe` without checking `mobFocus != null`.
findings.title: Wrong char lookup and missing mobFocus null check in messageSubCommand case 35 (PK type update)

findings.impact: Potential NullReferenceException or IndexOutOfRangeException crashing packet handling on malformed or racy server updates.
findings.root_cause: Missing null/bounds checks on Char.myCharz().charFocus (Controller.cs:5751), GameCanvas.panel.myMember index (ClanPacketHandler.cs:132), Char.myCharz().clan (ClanPacketHandler.cs:271), itemMap.template (ItemPacketHandler.cs:50), and arrItemBag[bagIndex] (ItemPacketHandler.cs:145); also signed readByte() used for array allocations in multiple places (Controller.cs:4645,5982, MapMovementPacketHandler.cs:86, TaskNpcPacketHandler.cs:89).
findings.title: Missing null/bounds checks and signed-byte array lengths in packet handlers

findings.impact: Stream desynchronization and corrupted inventory/skill state if any error occurs while reading body items or truncated cooldown packets.
findings.root_cause: Controller.cs:5897 swallows exceptions in arrItemBody loop and continues reading arrItemBag/arrItemBox from misaligned offset. CombatPacketHandler.cs:130 loops `while (available() > 0)` reading 6 bytes per entry without checking `available() >= 6`.
findings.title: Exception swallowing mid-stream in arrItemBody and missing 6-byte availability guard in SKILL_COOLDOWN

findings.impact: Built-in client auto-play/bot mod performs instant map coordinate teleportation, cross-map item pickup, and auto-PK teleportation; server must strictly enforce movement speed, pickup range, and cooldowns.
findings.root_cause: MobController.MoveTo and tsPlayer directly overwrite Char.myCharz().cx/cy and emit Service.gI().charMove(), while GetTypePickItem allows pickItem calls outside normal 100px radius when IsPickItemsDis/TDLT/IsTanSat is active.
findings.title: Client God module performs arbitrary coordinate teleportation and extended-range auto-pickup

findings.impact: Trade UI truncates or wraps opponent gold > 2,147,483,647 xu, and panel2 sets friendMoneyGD after rendering tab.
findings.root_cause: friendMoneyGD is read as 32-bit int via readInt() instead of 64-bit long; when GameCanvas.panel2 != null, setTabGiaoDich(false) is called on line 101 before assigning panel2.friendMoneyGD on line 102.
findings.title: TradePacketHandler reads friendMoneyGD as 32-bit int and updates panel2 money after tab init

findings.impact: writeString corrupts non-ASCII (Vietnamese) characters by truncating UTF-16 chars to sbyte; readString rejects strings >32767 bytes due to signed short length.
findings.root_cause: myWriter.writeString casts each char to sbyte (dropping high byte) instead of UTF-8 encoding; writeUTF/readString use signed short length.
findings.title: writeString truncates UTF-16 chars and writeUTF/readString use signed short length

findings.impact: Noticeable frame hitch on every map transition and continuous GC allocations during auto-farm update ticks.
findings.root_cause: Controller.loadInfoMap synchronously calls Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets() and GC.Collect() on main thread; MobController allocates int[2] in GetPointYsdMax and new MovePoint in Move during Update().
findings.title: Synchronous GC.Collect on map load and per-tick allocations in MobController

findings.impact: Duplicated item/template parsing logic and fragile split between legacy Controller.cs (~6900 lines) and modular PacketDispatcher handlers.
findings.root_cause: Controller remains a massive monolithic class containing createItem and newer loadItemNew side-by-side, while PacketDispatcher extracts only a subset of opcodes into IPacketHandler classes.
findings.title: Monolithic Controller.cs retains legacy template loaders alongside partial PacketDispatcher refactor

key_classes.name: Controller
key_classes.responsibility: Central client packet handler and game state loader (template creation, map/NPC/mob/item loading, sub-commands, login/character setup).

key_classes.name: PacketDispatcher
key_classes.responsibility: Maps opcode sbytes to modular IPacketHandler implementations and dispatches incoming Message instances.

key_classes.name: IPacketHandler (Auth, Clan, Combat, Item, MapMovement, PlayerStats, TaskNpc, Trade)
key_classes.responsibility: Modular packet handlers extracted from Controller for specific functional domains (auth alerts, clan, combat, map items, movement, stats, NPC/task UI, trade).

key_classes.name: Message
key_classes.responsibility: Binary network message wrapper holding sbyte command and myReader/myWriter streams.

key_classes.name: myReader
key_classes.responsibility: Big-endian binary stream reader over sbyte[] buffer with mark/reset support.

key_classes.name: myWriter
key_classes.responsibility: Big-endian auto-growing binary stream writer backing outgoing Message payloads.

key_classes.name: MobController
key_classes.responsibility: Client-side auto-farm, auto-pick, auto-PK, auto-heal, and skill-selection bot controller.

key_classes.name: MapController
key_classes.responsibility: Client-side helper for teleporting to map waypoints and triggering map transitions.

key_classes.name: PetService
key_classes.responsibility: Client-side auto-pet status polling and automatic Senzu bean healing loop.

module_summary: Client network serialization, modular packet dispatchers/handlers, Controller template/map/subcommand parsing, and Game1.God automation controllers (MapController, MobController, PetService). Covers big-endian binary framing (Message/myReader/myWriter), 8 domain IPacketHandler classes registered in PacketDispatcher, the tail half of monolithic Controller.cs (lines 4642-6894), and built-in client auto-play/teleportation helpers.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Dispatches incoming Message.command to 8 IPacketHandler instances: Auth, PlayerStats, TaskNpc, Clan, Trade, Item, MapMovement, Combat.
Reads data/map/skill/item template versions, cached RMS blobs, tilemap dimensions/tiles, exp table, PK status, rename dialog.
Reads server list URL UTF string and CanNapTien byte flag.
Reads full player info/inventory/box/skills/currencies (sub 0), HP/MP/xu updates, other player updates, skill shortcuts, skill upgrades, PK type, player context menu.
Reads Namek battlefield HUD state (phuban_Info type 0 sub 0,1,2,4,5) and optional cosmetics/banners/water/server messages (read_opt sub 0,2,3,4).
Reads alert UTF string and shows OK dialog, resetting login/map flags.
Reads clan chat/donate messages, full clan info + member list, member add/remove/update, member view list, clan search results, clan icon catalog/update.
Reads HP/damage/fatal/effectId, revive coordinates, pet-mob attack target index, and skillId+cooldown pairs.

protocol_touchpoints.opcode: ITEM_MAP_REMOVE(-21), PICK(-20), OTHER_PICK(-19), DROP(-18), OTHER_DROP(-14), ADD(68)
protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Reads ItemMap IDs, template IDs, coordinates, owner ID, and picked item text/quantity.
Reads map transition prep, respawn coords, move-fast target coords/chased charId, and teleport map/planet name lists.
Reads xu (long), luong (int), luongKhoa (int), maxStamina (short), stamina (short), nangdong (int).
Reads server big popup message with optional action button, NPC chat text/avatar, and NPC menu options.
Reads trade invites, open/cancel UI, remove item index, friend lock items + friendMoneyGD, and trade order confirmation.
